t: Highly effective flood prevention. Absorbs up to 20 litres of water or sewage and expands up to 40x its own weight. Versatile design will fit into openings and door wells. Contains easy-to-dispose pulp and super absorbent polymer. Simply slit the sack and disperse the contents into the earth. Suitable for landfill and incineration.
b: Creates a Water-Resistant Barrier to Floodwater
